intro.text: A member of the Ghostbloods, known only by a nickname.

items.text: In 1175 Icy Tongue was at a meeting in the Ghostblood safehouse that Shallan had infiltrated. She questioned the reason for the meeting and how Mraize's new orders, to hunt for Ba-Ado-Mishram's prison, would serve their goals; Mraize wouldn't say. She and seven others were left to lead the cell on Roshar, under Zora.

personality.text: She seems intelligent, careful and pragmatic, and isn't afraid to question Mraize's plans. She speaks with a Veden accent.
